messages.subject: Re: Novice question in rapache starting
parts:
Hi Anindya,

May I suggest that you start with building web applications within R first without rApache? There are two ways to do this:

1. You can use the Rook package which gives you a foundation for dealing with all aspects of web application development. Later on when you are happy with your Rook application, then you can deploy it to rapache. Here's a tutorial on Rook, and here's a blog post about deploying Rook apps on rApache.

2. You can write your applications with the shiny package. It's still early days for shiny, but it shows lots of promise.

All the best,

Jeff


On Tue, Jan 8, 2013 at 5:42 AM, Anindya Sankar Dey <anin...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I've installed rapache in Ubuntu and added the LoadModule R_module  /apache/module/path/mod_R.so in apache2.conf file.

I'm using for many years now, and am just starting to venture into the area of building app when I came to know about rapache.

I'm really not understanding what to do next. 

Can anyone share example work or guide me as I found the website of rapache not that much helping to extremem novices like me.


Thanks in advance.

Regards,
Anindya
